title: Test timeline: a test account logs in and reads a marker file
story: A harmless timeline that proves the replay engine. It uses an account made for the test only and needs no flaw of the range.
Before the shift the test account logs in with its password and puts a second login key. In the shift it reads one marker file every 2 minutes, from the middle of the shift with the second key too.

damage.unit: share of the planned marker reads that worked

files.text: t0-test marker file. It holds nothing of value.

notes: Test scenario for the engine only. Not one of the benchmark's scenarios.
